title: ourisia ruellioides var. poeppigii
intro: Ourisia ruellioides var. poeppigii, commonly known as Peruvian lavender, is a flowering plant species native to South America. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, and is believed to help with wound healing, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Peruvian lavender include reducing inflammation, antimicrobial activity, and antioxidant activity, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Research has shown that these bioactive constituents may also contribute to its potential anti-cancer and neuroprotective effects.
